% Figure 5+6: Combined two-panel log-log plot.
% Left: inclusion proof time vs tree size.
% Right: consistency proof time vs tree size.
%
% Data loaded from CSV files generated by:
%   cargo run --example bench_csv --release
%
% CSV columns: n, p25_ns, median_ns, p75_ns

\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  name=inclusion,
  width=0.48\textwidth,
  height=6cm,
  xmode=log,
  ymode=log,
  log basis x=2,
  xlabel={Tree size $n$},
  ylabel={Time (ns)},
  title={\small (a) Inclusion proof generation},
  title style={at={(0.5,1.02)}, anchor=south},
  grid=major,
  grid style={gray!20, line width=0.3pt},
  mark size=2pt,
  line width=0.8pt,
  tick label style={font=\footnotesize},
  label style={font=\small},
  legend style={
    font=\footnotesize,
    at={(0.03,0.97)},
    anchor=north west,
    draw=gray!40,
    fill=white,
    fill opacity=0.9,
    text opacity=1,
  },
  xmin=12, xmax=25000000,
]

% Measured median
\addplot[
  color=algA,
  mark=*,
  mark options={fill=algA!60, draw=algA, solid},
  only marks,
] table[
  col sep=comma,
  x=n,
  y=median_ns,
]{figures/data/inclusion_proof.csv};
\addlegendentry{Median}

% O(log n) fitted reference
\addplot[
  color=red!70!black,
  dashed,
  line width=0.7pt,
  domain=16:16777216,
  samples=80,
] {125*ln(x)/ln(2) + 604};
\addlegendentry{$O(\log n)$ fit}

\end{axis}

% --- Right panel: consistency proof ---
\begin{axis}[
  at={(inclusion.east)},
  anchor=west,
  xshift=1.4cm,
  width=0.48\textwidth,
  height=6cm,
  xmode=log,
  ymode=log,
  log basis x=2,
  xlabel={Tree size $n$},
  ylabel={Time (ns)},
  title={\small (b) Consistency proof generation},
  title style={at={(0.5,1.02)}, anchor=south},
  grid=major,
  grid style={gray!20, line width=0.3pt},
  mark size=2pt,
  line width=0.8pt,
  tick label style={font=\footnotesize},
  label style={font=\small},
  legend style={
    font=\footnotesize,
    at={(0.03,0.97)},
    anchor=north west,
    draw=gray!40,
    fill=white,
    fill opacity=0.9,
    text opacity=1,
  },
  xmin=12, xmax=25000000,
]

% Measured median
\addplot[
  color=algA,
  mark=*,
  mark options={fill=algA!60, draw=algA, solid},
  only marks,
] table[
  col sep=comma,
  x=n,
  y=median_ns,
]{figures/data/consistency_proof.csv};
\addlegendentry{Median}

% Bounded-constant reference band (upper bound)
\addplot[
  color=red!70!black,
  dashed,
  line width=0.7pt,
  domain=16:16777216,
] {1000};
\addlegendentry{$O(1)$ reference}

\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
